to: every character in the tavern instance (`instance_emit`). On hardcore servers too: `instance_emit` does not broadcast `dice`

variants.name: Roll
variants.when: The round of bets ended after 30 s. The server takes no more bets. The roll shows for 10 s.

variants.name: Lock
variants.when: 10 s after `roll`: the server settles the bets and shows the result and the key. The `tavern` results follow 1.6 s later.

variants.name: Bets
variants.when: 2 s after the results: a new round of bets starts, with the commitment of its number.

DiceRoll.summary: The dice table stops taking bets and rolls.

DiceLock.summary: The result of the dice round, with the key that proves the commitment.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The roll: 5 characters, two digits, a dot and two digits (`"00.00"` to `"99.99"`) (node/server_functions.js:1560-1568). Server bug: on a hardcore server, in 7% of the rounds the server replaces the number after the commitment with the roll of an earlier round (node/server_functions.js:1588-1590). `num` is then not the number in `text`, and the HMAC check of `text` still passes.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The committed text: `"Num: <num> Initials: <first letters of the names in the tavern> Random: <16 to 31 random characters>"`.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The HMAC key: 20 to 39 random characters. `HMAC-SHA256(key, text)` in hex must equal `hex` of the `bets` event of the round.

DiceBets.summary: A new round of dice bets, with the commitment to its number.

fields.name: hex
fields.description: `HMAC-SHA256(key, text)` as 64 hex characters. The `lock` event shows `key` and `text`.

senders.what: `tavern_loop` (every 1 s): each change of the state of the dice round.
